ideal: Every search that is asked before any scenario is known to be impossible leaves no unit out.
note: merged 'for every search' into one relative clause

ideal: When a scenario of a unit names a word, checker does not report the formula of any unit as lone on that word.
note: made the unconstrained unit explicit as 'any unit'

ideal: When a unit is held with units that cannot all hold, checker names it in its report of a contradiction.
note: collapsed repeated 'unit_1' to 'it'

ideal:
Both of these hold:
- When a unit holds a formula, is not a term, and no other formula can contradict its formula, checker reports its formula as lone on some signature.
- When checker reports a unit's formula as lone on a word, no other formula can contradict the formula of the unit.
note: kept the two-part axiom as a short list

ideal: When a quantifier's reading says its variable twice, verbalizer says it in full, with "there is" and the numbered name.
note: dropped the 'quantifier_1' numbering

ideal: When a unit holds a formula, has a statement, that statement does not sit between the markers of a generated region, and the formula can be said in words, the statement is handwritten.
note: folded the 'then' clause into the list's lead-in

ideal: When a unit's statement sits between the markers of a generated region, does not differ from what its formula says, and its formula can be said in words, the statement is current.
note: same fold as s120, for consistency

ideal: Checker cannot read a dangling frontmatter.
note: collapsed 'is a frontmatter checker cannot read' into a direct claim

ideal: When a unit that is not a term declares a word, that word is indeed one declared by a unit that is not a term.
note: formula is tautological (antecedent restates the consequent); kept it rather than simplifying it away

ideal: It must be possible for a quantifier's variable to be said once by the sentence while its condition is not about that variable.
note: fused the two bullet conditions onto one quantifier

ideal: When a quantifier's variable has a further condition and the quantifier fits a noun phrase, verbalizer says it with a relative clause, such as "a unit that is a spec".
note: 'it' for the repeated quantifier

ideal: It must be possible for a definition to have alternatives of one kind and an alternative that says something about another unit.
note: fused the two bullet conditions

ideal: When a unit holds a formula, is not a term, and its formula is lone on a signature, checker reports the formula as lone on that signature.
note: turned the list into a single clause

ideal: When a quantifier's variable the sentence says once and the quantifier fits a noun phrase, verbalizer says it as a noun phrase in place of the variable, such as "sits in no unit".
note: trimmed the 'quantifier_1' repetition

ideal: It must be possible for a list to be a rule whose two sides are each one clause and whose first side begins with a time phrase.
note: merged the two 'is a rule' clauses

ideal: When checker reports a unit's formula as lone on a word, the unit holds a formula and is not a term, the word is a signature, and the formula is lone on it.
note: 'it' for the repeated word

ideal: Now and at every later moment, when a call enters an owner that pulse has disposed, a call is throwing right after.
note: folded 'for every owner' into the condition

ideal: When a document keeps no readings and holds a unit, checker does not report that unit's formula as lone on any word.
note: kept 'that unit' explicit to avoid a pronoun clash with the document

ideal: It must be possible for a list to have a clause about a pair of variables and an item that is more than one clause.
note: fused the two 'has' bullets

ideal: When a unit is circular, checker reports a cycle for it.
note: 'it' for the repeated unit

ideal: When a test that project declares checks a claim, checker reports no untesting for it.
note: 'it' correctly points at the nearer noun, claim

ideal:
Both of these hold:
- When a plugin applies to a document, checker runs the plugin over the document.
- When the command line of a run does not name the document and checker runs the plugin over it, the plugin applies to the document.
note: kept explicit nouns to avoid a plugin/document mixup

ideal: When a claim names a site that no source holds, checker reports a mislocation for the claim.
note: kept 'the claim' explicit since 'site' is the nearer noun

ideal: When a definition has an alternative that does not begin with its kind, verbalizer says it as a list of the alternatives as they stand.
note: 'it' for the repeated definition

ideal: When a unit holds a formula with no keyword, the analyzer is asked to hold that formula.
note: minor trim only

ideal: Checker cannot read a stray frontmatter.
note: same collapse as s088

ideal: When no plugin gives a run code 1 or code 2, the run exits with code 0.
note: shortened the existential into 'no plugin gives'

ideal: A unit is circular exactly when it cites a unit that depends on it.
note: 'it' for the repeated unit_1

ideal: When an exception cites no spec, checker reports a freelancing for it.
note: 'it' for the repeated exception

ideal: When the project has no runner, checker reports no untesting for any unit.
note: kept 'any unit' explicit, since there is no antecedent noun to point at

ideal: When a bug cites a unit that is not a spec, checker reports a misnesting for the bug.
note: kept 'the bug' explicit to avoid pointing at 'unit'

ideal: A conflict is paired exactly when it names a unit and another unit.
note: 'it' for the repeated conflict

ideal: When a test checks a claim that is refined, checker reports an overreach for the test.
note: kept 'the test' explicit to avoid pointing at 'claim'

ideal:
For every term and every word: when the term declares the word, a reading in the term says the word, and some unit's claim, definition or fact uses it, then all of these hold:
- it is not a word that a reading says and nothing declares
- it is not a word declared in a unit that is not a term
- it is not a word whose reading is in another unit than its declaration
- it is not a word that no claim, definition or fact uses
- checker does not report it
note: 'it' throughout for the repeated word

ideal: When a quantifier says no variable differs from another and holds a condition, verbalizer says it in full, with "there is" and the numbered name.
note: 'it' for the repeated quantifier

ideal: Now and at every later moment, when pulse disposes an owner, code has registered a cleanup on it that has not run, the cleanup runs now or later.
note: folded 'the cleanup is on the owner' into one relative clause

ideal: When a run asks for a logic command, and either checker reports that some scenario cannot happen or some unit is held with units that cannot all hold, the run does not exit with code 0.
note: 'either/or' keeps the grouping unambiguous

ideal: It must be possible for a quantifier whose variable the sentence says once to also say that no variable differs from another and to hold a condition.
note: fused the two bullet conditions onto one quantifier

ideal:
Both of these hold:
- Now and at every later moment, when pulse disposes an owner, and two cleanups are registered on it, neither having run, one registered before the other, the later-registered cleanup runs now or at a later moment, and until it does, the earlier-registered cleanup does not run.
- Now and at every later moment, when a failing cleanup runs on an owner that pulse has disposed, the owner's dispose is not stopped, now or at any later moment.
note: used 'until it does' to carry the until-semantics naturally
